name: Vignettes: Ruby Red Lipstick
source:
How many memories can be distilled into a single phrase, a simple scent, a haunting melody. . .?

A short kinetic novel about a young woman named Gloria Nightingale, within four short segments centering around a moment in time that changed her life.

[Edited from [url=http://hazel-bun.itch.io/vignettes-ruby-red-lipstick]itch.io[/url]]
